title: Worked example: 9 funds down to 4
objectives: Walk the 9-to-4 consolidation and say what changed and what didn't.
Explain why the asset mix stays the same.
body_md:
Worked example (illustrative). Before: 9 equity funds — 3 large-cap funds, 2 flexi-cap funds, 1 large & mid-cap fund, 1 focused fund, 2 small SIPs in thematic funds. After: 4 equity funds — 1 index fund (core), 1 flexi-cap fund (core), 1 mid-cap fund (satellite), 1 small-cap fund (satellite). Same asset mix, fewer funds, easier tracking and fewer statements.

| Before: 9 equity funds | After: 4 equity funds |
| --- | --- |
| 3 large-cap funds | 1 index fund (core) |
| 2 flexi-cap funds | 1 flexi-cap fund (core) |
| 1 large & mid-cap fund | 1 mid-cap fund (satellite) |
| 1 focused fund | 1 small-cap fund (satellite) |
| 2 small SIPs in thematic funds | — |
example: 9 funds → 4 funds: same asset mix, fewer statements, easier tracking — consolidation changes the fund count, not the mix.
say: Consolidation is about jobs, not about selling everything.
never: Consolidation must change the asset mix.

check.why: After: 4 equity funds — 1 index fund (core), 1 flexi-cap fund (core), 1 mid-cap fund (satellite), 1 small-cap fund (satellite).

check.why: Before: 2 small SIPs in thematic funds. After: — (dropped).
